deployment_status: Working-tree implementation tested separately; running bot unchanged.
method: Recent uncached Instagram reel links from local request history; separate container with current deployment image dependencies and updated source, two-CPU cap; independent state/cache; real Telegram local API uploads and final file-ID sends to configured storage chat only.
limitations: Replay starts at downloader invocation; excludes Telegram polling, queue/admission, status messages, and client rendering.
Historical totals sum acquisition, storage upload, final user-send attempt and approximately 10ms queue; they are not controlled before/after samples.
Network conditions, CPU contention and Telegram-side content caching can affect timings.
No live photo/carousel measurements were made; album concurrency is covered by regression tests.
Identical resolution and CRF settings across encoder presets do not guarantee identical visual quality or file size.

Correction from account follow-up: benchmark copied saved sessions under BASE_DIR/sessions, but AccountManager resolves sessions relative to /app. The failed account-fallback replay therefore did not reproduce production saved-session access and must not be used to judge account health. Successful public-path timings are unaffected.

limitations: Selected native H264/AAC720x1280 rather than highest-resolution VP91080x1920; not an equal-quality comparison.
Probe directly queried public metadata, bypassing the failing fast-extractor attempt.
